Website information

Privacy Policy

Effective and last updated September 23, 2026

Scope

This policy explains how Integrative Pain Clinic handles information connected with this website. It applies to pages operated for the clinic and does not replace the privacy policies of Google, Helcim, YouTube, maps providers, or other external services linked from the site.

This website policy is separate from the clinic’s HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices. Contact the office for the current notice describing how protected health information may be used and disclosed and how you may exercise your health-information rights.

Information you provide

You may provide information when you call the clinic, complete a clinic form hosted by Google Forms, join a Google Meet appointment, use a payment page hosted by Helcim, or communicate through another service linked here. The information may include contact details, appointment information, payment details, and health-related information you choose to submit.

Those services process information under their own terms and privacy policies. Do not use a website form for an emergency. Call 911 for a medical emergency.

Information processed when you visit

The website host and access providers may process technical information needed to deliver and protect the site, such as an IP address, browser and device details, requested pages, timestamps, and security logs. This site also stores your cookie selection in your browser’s local storage. See the Cookie Policy for details.

How information may be used

  • To operate, maintain, secure, and improve the website.
  • To respond to questions and support appointment or patient-service requests.
  • To process transactions through an external payment provider.
  • To meet legal, regulatory, recordkeeping, and patient-care obligations.
  • To investigate misuse, fraud, or security concerns.

The clinic does not use this website to sell personal information or display targeted advertising.

How information may be shared

Information may be shared with vendors that support website hosting, forms, telehealth, payments, communications, and security; with professional advisers; when required by law; or when needed to protect patients, the clinic, or others. Vendors may process information under their own agreements and policies.

Security and retention

The clinic uses reasonable administrative and technical measures appropriate to the information and services involved. No internet service can guarantee complete security. Information is retained for as long as reasonably needed for patient care, operations, legal requirements, dispute resolution, and security.

Your choices

You may change the optional-media setting through “Cookie choices” in the footer. You can also clear site data through your browser. To ask about information held by the clinic, call the office. Rights may differ based on the information, applicable law, and the clinic’s recordkeeping duties.

Children

This website is not directed to children under 13. A parent or legal guardian should contact the clinic regarding a child’s care and should supervise the use of linked services.

Policy changes

This policy may be revised as the website, clinic practices, or legal requirements change. The date at the top shows the latest revision.
